name: Price of Power
source:
Price of Power is a wholesome adult visual novel focused on romance and adventure. Explore forgotten lands using your skills as a master hunter, romance your childhood best friend (and maybe others as well), and rediscover long-lost secrets about your world.

You and Maria dreamed of becoming adventurers one day, but life had other plans. Stripped of your family, best friend, and dreams for the future, you had to forge your own path.

Ten years later, though you've become the youngest master hunter in history, you find yourself wishing for more. When you bump into your long-lost childhood friend on a routine trip to the store, she pulls you out of your rut and into the adventure - and romance - of a lifetime.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1770210/Price_of_Power/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Price of Power》是一部主打恋爱与冒险的纯爱向成人视觉小说。运用你身为猎人大师的本领探索被遗忘的土地，与你的青梅竹马挚友（或许还有其他人）谈一场恋爱，重新发掘这个世界尘封已久的秘密。

你和玛丽亚曾梦想有朝一日成为冒险者，但命运另有安排。失去家人、挚友以及对未来的梦想后，你不得不独自开辟道路。

十年后，尽管你已成为了史上最年轻的猎人大师，内心却依然渴望着更多。当你在一次日常去商店采购的途中偶遇失散多年的青梅竹马时，她将你拉出了一成不变的生活，带你踏上了一生难忘的冒险——与恋爱之旅。

[引自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1770210/Price_of_Power/]Steam[/url]]
